title: NsConfig
description: NetScaler appliance configuration including network settings, system parameters, and operational options.

ipaddress.description: The NetScaler IP (NSIP) address of the appliance. This is the primary management IP address.

netmask.description: Subnet mask associated with the NSIP address.

nsvlan.description: VLAN ID for the NSIP address. Range 2-4094.

ifnum.description: Network interfaces bound to the NSVLAN. Format is slot/port (e.g., 1/1).

tagged.description: Whether the NSVLAN is tagged or untagged.

httpport.description: HTTP port(s) on the appliance. Default is 80.

maxconn.description: Maximum number of connections per service. Zero means unlimited.

maxreq.description: Maximum number of requests per connection. Zero means unlimited.

cip.description: Whether to insert the client IP address into the HTTP header of requests forwarded to the service.

cipheader.description: Name of the HTTP header used to insert the client IP address when CIP is enabled.

cookieversion.description: Version of the cookie inserted by the NetScaler for persistence.

securecookie.description: Whether the secure flag is set on persistence cookies.

pmtutimeout.description: Timeout in minutes for path MTU discovery. Range 1-1440.

ftpportrange.description: Port range for FTP data connections (e.g., 1024-65535).

timezone.description: Time zone setting for the appliance (e.g., GMT+05:30-IST-Asia/Kolkata).

grantquotamaxclient.description: Percentage of shared quota to be granted at a time for max client connections.

grantquotaspillover.description: Percentage of shared quota to be granted at a time for spillover threshold.

systemtype.description: The type of the NetScaler appliance.

primaryip.description: Primary IP address of the HA pair.

primaryip6.description: Primary IPv6 address of the HA pair.

lastconfigchangedtime.description: Timestamp of the last configuration change.

lastconfigsavetime.description: Timestamp of the last configuration save.

currentsytemtime.description: Current system time on the appliance.

systemtime.description: Current system time as epoch seconds.

configchanged.description: Whether the running configuration has unsaved changes.

mappedip.description: Mapped IP address for the NSIP.

range.description: Number of consecutive IP addresses in the range beginning with the mapped IP.
